title: A Gentle Watch Over the Night

sentences.text: The living room was quite chilly last night, with the temperature dropping to 17.0 °C at 05:40.
The check showed the living room stayed below 18.0 °C between 02:00 and 06:00.
Because the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, perhaps checking the heating would be a kind idea.
